prank_description: Rigged the auxiliary relay controls to play an obnoxiously loud fanfare whenever touched.
summary: enclave_01_hector set up a noisy prank on the relay controls for enclave_05_kaio; but enclave_05_kaio missed it entirely, leaving enclave_03_silas startled and grumbling at enclave_01_hector's antics.

science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Resolve the relay handoff and stabilize the ferrofluid shear.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Reinforce the Enclave against the incoming magnetosphere storm.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Master the raw energy of the planet's core.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Stormbreaker Spire thrusts defiantly into the bruised sky, its copper grounding lines humming with untamed current. Below, the dark ferrofluid sea rolls and twists, caught in a violent Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear that tears magnetic peaks from the liquid surface. Arc-lightning skips across the jagged iron outcrops, illuminating the precarious catwalks in stuttering flashes of intense violet light.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Stuttering violet arc-flashes against a bruised, heavy sky; churning black ferrofluid with silvery magnetic peaks.
sensory_palette.sound: The deep, resonating hum of strained copper lines punctuated by the sharp crack of atmospheric discharge.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone tang mixing with the sharp, metallic bite of vaporized iron.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A bone-rattling vibration ascending through the soles of the boots, accompanied by a biting, statically-charged wind.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A sparking control junction that can be bypassed to dump excess voltage.
A cresting magnetic wave that can be used to propel conductive debris.
A sheltered recess behind the main capacitor bank shielding from the wind and arcs.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To destabilize and collapse the precarious catwalks connecting the spire.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Rhythmically lashing the lowest supports with heavily magnetized liquid iron.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The shear wave creates a fluctuating magnetic field that disrupts equipment and makes footing treacherous.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: If ignored, the shear will snap the primary lower support strut, sending the catwalk plunging into the sea.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Hector must hand off the relay baton to Kaio before the static buildup overloads the system.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The ferrofluid shear is interfering with all local comms and mechanical relays, threatening to isolate the spire.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering this extreme environmental anomaly is key to surviving the imminent macro-storm.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If the relay handoff fails, the localized magnetic burst will fry the active sensory gear and escalate the shear wave.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Hector drops the baton straight into the ferrofluid, causing an immediate blowout of the local grid.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: The handoff is fumbled; the baton is secured but Kaio takes a nasty static shock, delaying their next action.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: A seamless, dynamic pass-off through the howling wind, keeping the relay perfectly synchronized.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: A flawless pass that simultaneously grounds the static charge, momentarily neutralizing the shear wave and revealing a stable magnetic undercurrent.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector hurls himself across the gap, arm extended with the glowing relay baton towards Kaio.
